title: Toward Interference-Agnostic RF Source Separation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Separating a radio-frequency signal of interest from a co-channel interference is mostly addressed with specialized separators, each trained for one pair of signal and interference types and therefore relying on a label that a heavily jammed receiver cannot identify. We show that this reliance is not benign: applied to an interference it was not trained on, such a separator usually fails to recover the signal, and in most of the cases we measure it leaves the signal worse than no processing at all. We then train a single separator over every pair, giving it no indication at test time of which one it faces, on two architectures with no component in common: the convolutional WaveNet of the ICASSP 2024 RF Challenge, and a band-split transformer that we adapt from music source separation. translated_title: 迈向干扰无关的射频信号源分离
translated_abstract: 将感兴趣的射频信号从同频干扰中分离出来，目前主要依靠专用分离器实现——每个分离器只针对一对特定的信号与干扰类型进行训练，因而依赖于一个严重受扰的接收机无法识别的标签。我们证明这种依赖并非无害：当这类分离器被应用于其未曾训练过的干扰时，通常无法恢复信号，并且在我们测量的大多数情况下，处理后的信号甚至比不做任何处理更糟。为此，我们在所有信号-干扰对上训练一个统一分离器，并在测试时不向其提供任何关于所面对干扰类型的信息，采用了两种没有任何共同组件的架构：ICASSP 2024 射频挑战赛的卷积 WaveNet，以及我们从音乐源分离领域改造而来的频带切分 Transformer（band-split transformer）。两者表现一致：在仅相当于一个专用模型的规模下，该统一分离器的性能接近于它所替代的全部专用模型，保持误码率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出在所有信号-干扰对上训练单一统一分离器，测试时无需识别干扰类型，就能以单个专用模型的规模达到接近全部专用模型的分离性能，并在面对未训练过的干扰时避免信号质量恶化。
en_tdlr: This paper trains a single interference-agnostic RF source separator across all signal-interference pairs, which at the size of one specialized model performs close to all the specialized models it replaces while avoiding their degradation on unseen interference.
